nodes.rationale: Token revogável via CLI admin — chosen for revocable token management

nodes.label: SQLite Database Choice
nodes.rationale: Zero overhead, perfeito para RPi — minimal resource usage for Raspberry Pi deployment

nodes.label: Fastify Backend Choice
nodes.rationale: ~2x mais rápido que Express, schema validation — performance and built-in validation

nodes.label: API Cache Strategy
